title: Coffman Conditions for Deadlock
description: Which of the following is NOT one of the four mandatory Coffman conditions required for a deadlock to occur?
explanation: The four Coffman conditions are: 1) Mutual Exclusion, 2) Hold and Wait, 3) No Preemption (resources cannot be forcibly taken), and 4) Circular Wait.

title: Belady's Anomaly Occurrence
description: Belady's Anomaly (where increasing the number of page frames results in an increased number of page faults) primarily occurs in which page replacement algorithm?
explanation: FIFO page replacement algorithm suffers from Belady's anomaly because it does not belong to the class of stack-based page replacement algorithms (unlike LRU and OPT).

title: Isolation Levels & Dirty Read Anomaly
description: Which SQL transaction isolation level prevents 'Dirty Reads' but still allows 'Non-Repeatable Reads'?
explanation: Read Committed ensures that any data read is committed at the moment it is read, eliminating dirty reads. However, non-repeatable reads can still happen if another transaction modifies and commits data concurrently.

title: Nth Highest Salary Query
description: Write a SQL query using window functions (DENSE_RANK) or LIMIT/OFFSET to retrieve the 2nd highest unique salary from the Employee table.

starter_code.sql: SELECT DISTINCT salary FROM Employee ORDER BY salary DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1;

explanation: DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY salary DESC) allows ranking distinct salaries consecutively without skipping rank positions.

title: TCP 3-Way Handshake Sequence
description: What is the standard packet exchange sequence in establishing a TCP connection?
explanation: Client sends SYN, server replies with SYN-ACK, and client acknowledges with ACK to establish a full-duplex TCP stream.

title: Runtime Polymorphism Mechanism
description: In Object-Oriented Programming (such as C++ or Java), runtime polymorphism is primarily achieved through which mechanism?
options: Method Overriding with Virtual Functions / Dynamic Dispatch
explanation: Method Overriding using dynamic dispatch (vtable/vptr in C++, dynamic method invocation in Java) achieves runtime polymorphism.
